title: Vermont parcel identifiers added; fab-to-parcel geography remains unresolved

publication_effect: Additive context on four existing readings and their hub cards, with three source pins and the scoped table in the existing export. No current legal-title finding, fab-boundary determination, portfolio admission, independent approval, deployment or launch.
